## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run build` passes locally (all four languages, no broken link).
- [ ] I looked at the changed pages in the built site (`npm run serve`).
- [ ] Facts changed in all four languages, or I say below which ones are left for a maintainer.
- [ ] Interface labels are quoted exactly as the console shows them.
- [ ] No real names, customer names, credentials, internal URLs or personal data, including in screenshots.
- [ ] New dependencies, if any, are pinned to an exact version.
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`), see CONTRIBUTING.md.
